config.fitting_policy: DCS: fixed-cloud reverse KL, seed 42, gradient-norm cap 10, no coordinate/CDF clipping. SCS: unchanged author VI, fixed base batch, seed 0, coordinate clip 1000, no gradient clipping. Both use Adam 0.01, fixed reference clouds, equal update counts and equal cloud sizes; base distributions and parameterizations differ. Fitting costs are recorded per family.
config.threshold_policy: Original threshold 50 multiplied by sqrt(d/100); fixed before sampling.
config.target_note: Analytic multivariate-t radial law; the normal-CDF sign skew leaves this law unchanged.
config.tuning_note: Every method receives the same separate warmup-transition budget. DCS-RWM and DCS-BW use acceptance-target 0.234 dual averaging. Reflected BW retains its ball-movement pilots without a geometric step ceiling of 2. DCS-Billiard calibrates its own production kernel using bounded squared changes of physical log(1+norm), including zero after rejection. SCS uses the paper skew-t fixed h=0.1, with the same discarded warmup budget and no step adaptation. The final pilot state and selected step initialize production; all steps freeze before sampling.
config.time_scope: Equal per-chain sampling time includes first-third burn-in, every transition and all-state radial estimates and unthinned scalar capture for ESS. VI, separate step calibration, compilation, synchronization waits, ESS computation and file/report generation are excluded and recorded separately. All methods use JAX full-state scans.
config.reference_policy: Analytic Student-t radial references; no coordinate-reference simulation

ball.objective: reverse KL on independent base draws
ball.fitting_policy: DCS fixed-batch reverse KL, Adam 0.01, gradient-norm cap 10; no coordinate/CDF clipping

sphere.objective: author reverse KL; target and Jacobian evaluated at clipped physical coordinates
sphere.target_note: Original DCS target; differs from the SCS paper Student-t-CDF skew target
sphere.fitting_policy: Original SCS author reverse KL, fixed base draws with seed 0, Adam 0.01, physical-coordinate clip 1000; no gradient clipping
